title: Claude Code Edit race can overwrite files outside the macOS workspace
summary: A sandboxed process can swap a workspace directory for a symlink between validation and the unsandboxed Edit write, redirecting the write outside the workspace.

severity.rationale: Sandbox escape requires attacker-controlled code already running inside the Bash sandbox, such as a dependency script. That prerequisite is common in coding-agent workflows and warrants a 72-hour response.

exposure: macOS sessions executing untrusted repository or dependency code inside the Bash sandbox are exposed.

remediation.details: Update Claude Code to 2.1.251 or later. The vendor says standard auto-update users received the fix; verify the version rather than assuming it.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
